modules.module_title: Receive incoming material in stores/stock yard at the construction site

pcs.pc_description: check the delivery challan and invoice produced by the carrier against the copy of purchase order
check that quality and quantity of incoming material is as per the purchase order or material requisition
check for the test certificate of material in case of steel, cement, admixtures, electrical items, mechanical items, machineries etc
arrange for weighing of incoming bulk material as per standard practices
carry out volumetric measurement of incoming material as per applicability
co-ordinate with quality department for inspection of incoming materials as per standard practices
arrange for unloading of material subject to acceptance from quality department/user and clearance for unloading
report to store in-charge in case of shortage and if material is rejected/ not accepted from quality department/user

modules.module_title: Make entries in register and prepare various reports for received as per organization policies

pcs.pc_description: record appropriate entries on the delivery note, get approval from store in-charge and return a copy of same to the carrier

maintain the daily goods receipt register /Goods Inward Register mentioning details such as date and time of receipt, name of the supplier, name and detail of carrier, challan number and date, item code, details and description, quantity and value of items, purchase order reference, carrier details, goods inward note reference, rejected memo reference, received by, inspected by etc.
prepare Good Inspection Note (GIN) after material in inspected and approved by the Quality Department
update details related to current stock of materials in stock maintenance as per standard practices
perform all other documentation and filing works related to the received and stocked materials in store/stock yards
inform user departments about the availability or non-availability of material requisitioned by them
carry out periodic meeting with the site team for material requirement and reconciliation
inform site team about the soon to be expiring material in advance for faster consumption of the material at site

modules.module_title: Arrange storage of materials received at site stores/stock yard

pcs.pc_description: ensure appropriate personal protective equipment (PPEs) are used by helper while handling of materials in stores/stock yards
identify hazards associated with the handling of materials
determine handling characteristic of materials and ensure correct manual/mechanical methods is used when loading, unloading, shifting and placing of materials
ensure appropriate rigging gears such as slings, shackles, lifting belts, steel ropes, chain block etc. are used for lifting and shifting of heavy weight material, components and equipment
ensure stacks/piles of material are stable so as to aid safe handling and loading
ensure materials are stored, stacked/stockpiled as per store layout plan for ease of identification, retrieval and prevention of damage
provide suitable label/tagging/coding and store material at appropriate location
ensure that bagged materials like cement bags, Plaster of Paris bags(POP), Gypsum Bags are stored above ground level in a covered area, free from moisture
ensure reinforcement steel or structural steel are stacked over wooden sleepers above ground levels, based on their classification, sizes and length
ensure safe stacking of bricks and blocks as per standard practices

modules.module_title: Arrange safe storage of hazardous and inflammable materials at site/ stock yards

pcs.pc_description: ensure plywood, timber, gypsum boards, fibre board are stacked and stored on a flat platform above ground level in a covered, clean and dry place
ensure safe handling and storing of hazardous material as per environment, health and safety norms
ensure safe handling and storing of inflammable material as per environment, health and safety norms
check that work area is cleared of waste, cleaned, restored and secured in line with workplace procedures
